cannot.name: A website or web pages
cannot.plain: The bot has no website, web pages, admin panel or domain of its own, and cannot open a mini app inside Telegram.
cannot.why: The product lives entirely inside the Telegram chat.
cannot.workaround: Everything happens in the chat with buttons.

cannot.name: Receiving events other services send
cannot.plain: The bot cannot receive events that other services send to it by themselves, such as GitHub notifications or form submissions.
cannot.why: Other services have nowhere to send such events to.
cannot.workaround: The bot checks the service itself from time to time, if the service allows that.

cannot.name: Accepting payments
cannot.plain: The bot cannot take payments: neither through payment services such as YooKassa or Stripe nor inside Telegram (Stars, Payments).
cannot.why: Payment acceptance is not part of what the platform builds.

cannot.name: Signing in with Google and the like
cannot.plain: The bot cannot use "Sign in with Google" or similar sign-in buttons to reach a user's account.
cannot.why: Such sign-in needs a web page for the user to return to, which the bot does not have.
cannot.workaround: The user shares their spreadsheet or calendar with the bot's Google service account, or pastes a personal token.

cannot.name: Sending email by itself
cannot.plain: The bot cannot send email by itself.
cannot.why: The bot has no mail service of its own.
cannot.workaround: Send through an email service with a key the user provides, or send the message in Telegram.

cannot.name: Keeping uploaded files
cannot.plain: The bot does not keep uploaded files itself.
cannot.why: The bot remembers data, not files.
cannot.workaround: Photos and documents stay in Telegram and the bot remembers them; large files go to an external storage service with a key the user provides.

cannot.name: Direct access to the bot's data store
cannot.plain: Nobody can connect to the bot's data store directly.
cannot.why: The data is reachable only through the bot.
cannot.workaround: The bot hands out the data needed through a command, such as an export or a report.

cannot.name: Backups of the data
cannot.plain: There are no backups of the bot's data; if the server is lost, the bot's data is lost with it.
cannot.why: The platform makes no copies of the bot's data.
